about: u1 migrates the count line to idea-mara; u2 is an edit a comment asked for in idea-tobias. After `pointers`, a copy step stands in for u1's copy going missing. The real Edit guard raises copy-mismatch on b1-u1 and writer-line-edited on b1-u2. `act` at pointed undoes b1-u1 (a note changed: edited true). b1-u2 is approved and a comment started it, so f2 stands: nothing goes to the migration-verifier, no verify-flags.json is written, and the step is acted with next_check 2, because `act` changed a note. The second check drops f2, which stood, the way it drops a flag judged asked for, and skips the undone unit: [].
